# eDrama Documentation

> How to install, configure and rebrand eDrama by WRTeam: a short-drama streaming app (Flutter, Android and iOS), its Laravel backend and Admin Panel, the Creator Portal and the Next.js website.

Viewers watch episodes of a few minutes and unlock more with coins, a rewarded ad, a Series Pass (one purchase for a whole series) or VIP. These guides cover setting up each part on your own servers and stores.

## Guides

- [Admin Panel](https://wrteam-in.github.io/edrama-doc/admin-panel/): requirements, installation, environment, background jobs, settings, monetization and the go-live checklist
- [Mobile App](https://wrteam-in.github.io/edrama-doc/mobile-app/): app name, package name, logo and icons, colours, Firebase, push, ads and purchases, deep links, languages and release builds
- [Website](https://wrteam-in.github.io/edrama-doc/website/): local setup, connecting to the backend, deploying to Vercel or other hosts, editing content, languages and app links
- [Creator Portal](https://wrteam-in.github.io/edrama-doc/creator-portal/): becoming a creator, publishing a series and the review queue
- [Features](https://wrteam-in.github.io/edrama-doc/features/): the viewer app, coins and unlocks, how earnings work and the Admin Panel menus
